_note: Conditions are cited from the papers the World Privacy Forum 2023 report 'Risky Analysis' cites. Each quote is a short excerpt as supplied, not yet checked word for word against the paper. See base/README.md.

conditions.text: Recasting the four-fifths rule as an AI fairness metric introduces new potential for ethical harms.
conditions.citation: Watkins, McKenna, Chen (2022). The four-fifths rule is not disparate impact: a woeful tale of epistemic trespassing in algorithmic fairness.
conditions.quote: incorrectly introduces a new deontic nuance and new potentials for ethical harms

conditions.text: Shapley values used as feature importance raise mathematical problems.
conditions.citation: Kumar, Venkatasubramanian, Scheidegger, Friedler (2020). Problems with Shapley-value-based explanations as feature importance measures. ICML.
conditions.quote: We show that mathematical problems arise when Shapley values are used for feature importance

conditions.text: Shapley values miss information about model predictions that the authors' Shapley residuals capture.
conditions.citation: Kumar, Scheidegger, Venkatasubramanian, Friedler (2021). Shapley Residuals: Quantifying the limits of the Shapley value for explanations. NeurIPS.
conditions.quote: demonstrate that they capture information about model predictions that Shapley values cannot.

conditions.text: Explanation methods that rely on input perturbations, including LIME and SHAP, are not reliable.
conditions.citation: Slack, Hilgard, Jia, Singh, Lakkaraju (2020). Fooling LIME and SHAP: Adversarial Attacks on Post hoc Explanation Methods. AIES.
conditions.quote: post hoc explanations techniques that rely on input perturbations, such as LIME and SHAP, are not reliable

conditions.text: Model-agnostic interpretation methods can lead to wrong conclusions when applied incorrectly.
conditions.citation: Molnar et al. (2022). General Pitfalls of Model-Agnostic Interpretation Methods for Machine Learning Models.
conditions.quote: can lead to wrong conclusions if applied incorrectly

conditions.text: Explanation methods that rely on input perturbations, including LIME and SHAP, are not reliable.
conditions.citation: Slack, Hilgard, Jia, Singh, Lakkaraju (2020). Fooling LIME and SHAP: Adversarial Attacks on Post hoc Explanation Methods. AIES.
conditions.quote: post hoc explanations techniques that rely on input perturbations, such as LIME and SHAP, are not reliable

conditions.text: When the explanation is made very local, LIME's surrogate model can degenerate.
conditions.citation: Gaudel, Galárraga, Delaunay, Rozé, Bhargava (2022). s-LIME: Reconciling Locality and Fidelity in Linear Explanations. IDA.
conditions.quote: with the current design of LIME, the surrogate model may degenerate when the explanation is too local
